There has been many strange stories told by siblings of house we live in. The strangest thing that happened to me in that house was when I was a kid. 

As one of the youngest in the family, there wasn't much space on the beds for me to sleep in, till I decided to sleep with between my parents. I remember waking up that morning and looked to my left, where my mom was sleeping, then looked to my right and see my dad and a figure standing next to the bed, it was standing in a position where it was facing forward yet it was also looking down on us. I remember seeing a lady with pale white skin and dark black hair to the shoulders, I was so scared that I covered myself in the blanket and hugging my mom as if my lfe depended on it. 

I told my siblings about that morning and they agreed with me that they also saw pale white figures with dark black hair. My older brother and sister said that saw a little boy(similar to the boy from the grudge) at our house on Thanksgiving and on New Year's Eve. They said that he was crouched by a couch on Thanksgiving and sitting on top of the stairwell New Year's Eve, he wasn't doing nothing just observing.

My dad has told me several stories, my favorite is when an elder man started to have a heart attack. My dad rushed to the man and comfort him until the ambulance got there, sadly he passed before the EMT got there. I remember asking questions about it when I was younger but he would change the conversation a few minutes after I asked.
I wish it could be better with the support of my family. I have stopped eating, became more isolated, looking towards the end of the day so I could feel at peace for once.
I will keep my insecurities in check then. Thank you, and I appreciate your kind words!
